# NEW 2026-11-24 v26.0 WP14: Systemic Fourth Rome (ELR) Isolation & Cross-Era Pacing Core (0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides, 0 bare ELR tag refs). Generated by gen_v260_fourth_rome_isolation.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Strictly 0 bare if/else/else_if in scripted_triggers (EU5 1.4.9 hard rule).
# Strictly 0 bare `tag = ELR` references so OEBYZ loads with 0 unknown-tag errors when run standalone
# without `oebyz.phoenix.1453_fourth_rome`, while catching 100% of Fourth Rome voyagers and landed ELR hosts.

# Country scope. True for any Fourth Rome / Nova Elysia voyager or American exile realm.
oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
		has_variable = oe_ely_voyager
		has_variable = oe_ely_shell_swapped
		has_variable = oe_elr_exile_country
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
			exists = capital
			capital.continent = continent:america
			OR = {
				culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = TRE
				has_or_had_tag = FEO
				has_or_had_tag = ROM
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True while Fourth Rome is in Act I/II New World isolation (before rediscovering
# the Old World AND consolidating a substantial continental realm of 25+ locations).
oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = {
	oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
		NOT = { has_discovered = location:constantinople }
		NOT = { has_discovered = location:lisbon }
		num_locations < 25
	}
}

# Country scope. Canonical gate for Class A Old-World / Eurasia / Imperial showcase events & decisions.
# Permanently blocks Fourth Rome exile countries from Old-World-only events (Forbidden City, Eurasian Steppe,
# Old-World Mediterranean orders, etc.).
oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
}

# Country scope. Canonical gate for Class A 1337-bookmark meta-showcase / centennial chronicle events
# that also make no sense when starting in 1453 / 1648 / 1776.
oe_main_mod_1337_showcase_allowed = {
	oe_start_is_1337 = yes
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
}

# Country scope. Canonical gate for Class B generic empire / estate / reactive / warfare flavor events.
# Blocks Fourth Rome during Act I/II isolation AND enforces a 12-month cross-module player popup throttle
# so multiple independent systems never burst on the same January tick.
oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
	OR = {
		is_ai = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_player_global_flavor_cd }
	}
}
